start.npc_text: Commander Vance glances up from holographic telemetry maps. 'You look like someone looking for work—or running from trouble. Which is it?'

options.text: I'm looking for contract work in this sector.
[Persuasion 4] I noticed the security alerts regarding the Valkyrie freighter.
[Corporate Operative] I'm here under Aegis authority to audit classified signal anomalies.

node_work.npc_text: 'Simple enough. A science vessel, the Valkyrie, went dark 48 hours ago. We need someone to board it, retrieve its datalogs, and ensure no biohazards breach Khepri.'

options.text: Consider it done. I'll head to the Valkyrie.
What are you paying for this breach job?

node_valkyrie_secret.npc_text: 'Smart move picking up on that. Truth is, the Valkyrie wasn't just a freighter—it was housing an experimental AI core. Fetch the datapad, and I'll double your bounty.'

options.text: Agreed. I'll retrieve the AI datapad.

node_corp_auth.npc_text: Vance stands straight and salutes. 'Understood, Operative. All Valkyrie access clearance codes have been transferred directly to your ship.'

options.text: Good. Stand by for my report.

node_pay.npc_text: '500 credits standard, plus hazard bonuses if you clear out rogue drones.'

node_end.npc_text: 'May the solar winds favor you out there.'
